name: cafe-cup-clear
goal: 카페 컵 재발주 — 불투명 종이컵 반려. 투명 클리어 컵(아이스 컵)으로: 내부가 비쳐 보여야 액체 레이어가 '안에 담긴' 그림이 됨.
style: bold clean dark outlines, energetic comic cartoon sticker style, flat cel shading
common: no text, no watermark, transparent background PNG with alpha, single centered subject, slight 3/4 top-down view

items.label: 투명 클리어 컵
items.subject: an EMPTY transparent clear plastic iced-coffee cup: the interior must be see-through (mostly transparent), drawn only with thin outlines, subtle white rim strokes and a couple of diagonal glass shine highlights, slightly tapered shape, no lid, no straw, no liquid
